item.title: Michael Jackson & Madonna Are Both on the Hot 100 Again: When Did That Last Happen?
item.description:
[Upbeat music plays in the background]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music trends. Today, we're talking about two music legends who are back on the Billboard Hot 100 chart together. That's right, the King and Queen of Pop, Michael Jackson and Madonna, are sharing the spotlight once again.
[Short music transition]
Host: Michael Jackson's classic hits are experiencing a resurgence, thanks to the new biopic "Michael". Four of his songs have re-entered the chart, with "Billie Jean" leading the way at number 17. "Human Nature", "Beat It", and "Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough" are also back on the chart, thanks to a significant increase in streaming numbers.
[Short music transition]
Host: Meanwhile, Madonna has returned to the Hot 100 chart with her new collaboration with Sabrina Carpenter, "Bring Your Love". The duet debuts at number 74, with over 4 million streams and 6 million airplay audience impressions.
[Short music transition]
Host: This marks the first time in over 22 years that Michael Jackson and Madonna have shared spots on the Hot 100 chart. They have a long history of appearing on the chart together, dating back to 1983. In fact, they've had numerous number one hits and have dominated the chart's top 10 together.
[Short music transition]
Host: It's great to see these two music legends back on the chart, and we can't wait to see what's next for them. That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one.
[Outro music plays]
